title: Projection-product interaction

new_result.name: QFORM-SHAREDBANK-PROJECTEDSQUARE-HYPERBOLIC-CURVEDCAP-v1
new_result.statement: If (S,U) has arbitrary joint density cap M, V is independent with density cap N, and Q=a(S+d)^2+2b(U+alpha)(V+beta)+r0 with ab nonzero, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 6(MN)^(2/3)(|a|b^2)^(-1/3). For disjoint original-coordinate source banks with S=r^T X_I, U=u^T X_I, V=v^T X_J, this gives ||p_Q||_infinity <= 12[|a|b^2 det(G)||v||^2]^(-1/3). For the exact-rank-three core A=a rr^T+b(uv^T+vu^T) with three nonzero eigenvalues of modulus at least one, ||p_(X^TAX)||_infinity <=12.
new_result.source_provenance: S and U may be dependent projections of the same original-coordinate product bank and are used only through their true joint density cap. V comes from a disjoint original-coordinate bank and is genuinely independent of the vector (S,U). No post-rotation independence or conditional projection cap is used.

strict_target_witness: Flat orthonormal sign projections S,U on one m-coordinate bank and flat V on a disjoint m-coordinate bank give Q_m=S^2+2UV with nonzero spectrum {1,1,-1}; the new theorem gives ||p_Qm||_infinity<=12 uniformly in m and all cap-one physical source laws, while physical coefficients are O(1/m) and relevant physical pair minors are O(1/m^2).

applied_results: ruled one-sheet bound p_Q(s)<=pi*sqrt(2) on the majority-sign side
twisted characteristic-function Lp bound in the sharper diffuse subcase
